metadata.note: Edit to update chain PQC status. Push to trigger rebuild.

chains.name: Ethereum
chains.detail: leanXMSS (hash-based signatures) + leanVM zkVM for 250x signature aggregation. EIP-8141 under consideration for Hegotá hard fork (H2 2026). Buterin presented full architecture at ETHDenver Feb 2026. Beam Chain production coding underway, deployment targeted 2029-30.
chains.exposure: All historical public keys visible on-chain

chains.name: Bitcoin
chains.detail: BIP-360 (Pay-to-Merkle-Root) proposed Feb 2026 for quantum-safe addresses. BIP-361 (Apr 2026) adds 3-phase legacy signature sunset: Phase A blocks sending to legacy (T+3yr), Phase B invalidates ECDSA/Schnorr signatures (T+5yr), Phase C proposes zk-proof recovery for frozen coins.
chains.exposure: ~6.7M BTC in vulnerable addresses with on-chain public keys; reused addresses and spent outputs expose public keys

chains.name: Solana
chains.detail: Community discussion increased following Project Eleven 15-bit ECDLP demo (Apr 2026). No formal proposal yet.
chains.exposure: All validator and user public keys on-chain

chains.name: Algorand
chains.detail: State proofs use Falcon (NIST PQC finalist). Partial PQC integration.
chains.exposure: Partial — state proofs are PQ-secure, transaction sigs are not
watch: Full transaction signature migration to PQC

chains.name: Cosmos
chains.detail: No public PQC discussion in governance or development.
chains.exposure: All public keys on-chain via IBC

chains.name: Polkadot
chains.detail: Some research discussion in Web3 Foundation context.
watch: RFC or governance proposal for PQC migration

chains.name: Cardano
chains.detail: No formal PQC plan despite research-oriented development philosophy.
